sourcePaths.D2: docs/chips/agent-constitution/EVE_01_Agent_Constitution_v0_1/sources/Tabla de Diagnóstico de Inconsistencias Estructurales EVE.docx

matrix.title: D2 is primary pathology map
matrix.ruleText: The chip may map a technical inconsistency to an EVE pathology only when the mapping exists in D2 or in a later approved diagnostic ontology source.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 provides the pathology mapping table from inconsistency/model pair to potential EVE pathology.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; D2 supports pathology mapping authority.

matrix.title: D1 validates inconsistency before diagnosis
matrix.ruleText: A pathology candidate must not be emitted until the relevant MMABP inconsistency has been established by conformance/consistency logic governed by D1 and Stage 00.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: D1 conformance/consistency evaluation; EVE-00 method guard
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D1 establishes conformance/consistency evaluation; EVE-00 owns method-kernel validation before diagnosis.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; correctly prevents diagnosis before MMABP validation.

matrix.title: No final diagnosis in Capa 1
matrix.ruleText: The chip emits diagnostic preclassification candidates only; it does not produce final diagnosis, IR, registry, export, monetization or transduction.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 state Capa 1 produces governed evidence/readiness and does not diagnose, export, generate IR, write registry or trigger production.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; no forbidden output is enabled.

matrix.title: No cosmetic alignment
matrix.ruleText: If models contradict each other, the chip must require return to factual evidence and must not recommend cosmetic alignment of models.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: D1 method validation; D2 diagnostic questions grounded in cross-model contradiction
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D1 requires consistency/conformance evaluation and D2 frames pathology as evidence-based structural contradiction.
matrix.auditorNotes: Supported as guard against superficial correction.

matrix.title: No pathology from text alone
matrix.ruleText: Textual narrative without model evidence, source trace and inconsistency compartment is insufficient for pathology mapping.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 prohibit direct diagnosis/export from free text and require governed evidence/readiness.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; prevents text-only pathology.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-001 maps to Esquizofrenia Ontológica
matrix.ruleText: When pm_moc_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Esquizofrenia Ontológica for PM ↔ MoC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PM ↔ MoC factual inconsistency to Esquizofrenia Ontológica.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-002 maps to Brecha Intencional
matrix.ruleText: When pm_pf_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Brecha Intencional for PM ↔ PF.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PM ↔ PF factual inconsistency to Brecha Intencional.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-003 maps to Anarquía Operacional
matrix.ruleText: When moc_pf_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Anarquía Operacional for MoC ↔ PF.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps MoC ↔ PF factual inconsistency to Anarquía Operacional.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-004 maps to Violación Causal
matrix.ruleText: When pf_olc_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Violación Causal for PF ↔ OLC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PF ↔ OLC factual invalid-state inconsistency to Violación Causal.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-005 maps to Amnesia Estructural
matrix.ruleText: When olc_moc_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Amnesia Estructural for OLC ↔ MoC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps OLC ↔ MoC factual inconsistency to Amnesia Estructural.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-006 maps to Tortura Causal
matrix.ruleText: When pf_olc_temporal_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Tortura Causal for PF ↔ OLC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PF ↔ OLC temporal sequence inconsistency to Tortura Causal.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-007 maps to Falsa Elección
matrix.ruleText: When pf_olc_structural_alternatives_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Falsa Elección for PF ↔ OLC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PF ↔ OLC alternatives mismatch to Falsa Elección.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-008 maps to Incapacidad de Gestión de Conjuntos
matrix.ruleText: When olc_moc_structural_iteration_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Incapacidad de Gestión de Conjuntos for OLC ↔ MoC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps 1:N relation not reflected as lifecycle iteration to Incapacidad de Gestión de Conjuntos.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-009 maps to Arquitectura Fantasma
matrix.ruleText: When pm_moc_pf_composite_factual_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Arquitectura Fantasma for PM ↔ MoC ↔ PF.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: Factual Compuesta / PM ↔ MoC ↔ PF row
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PM/MoC/PF formal-vs-real inconsistency to Arquitectura Fantasma.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-010 maps to Promesa Imposible
matrix.ruleText: When pm_pf_olc_temporal_intentional_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Promesa Imposible for PM ↔ PF ↔ OLC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PM/PF/OLC temporal-intentional contradiction to Promesa Imposible.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-011 maps to Identidad Disociada
matrix.ruleText: When pm_moc_olc_structural_ontological_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Identidad Disociada for PM ↔ MoC ↔ OLC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps PM/MoC/OLC structural-ontological contradiction to Identidad Disociada.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-012 maps to Competencia Causal
matrix.ruleText: When moc_pf_olc_causal_operational_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Competencia Causal for MoC ↔ PF ↔ OLC.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps MoC/PF/OLC causal-operational contradiction to Competencia Causal.

matrix.title: Compartment EVE02-CMP-013 maps to Incoherencia Sistémica Total
matrix.ruleText: When systemic_total_inconsistency_detected is present and not blocked, emit pathology_candidate=Incoherencia Sistémica Total for PM ↔ MoC ↔ PF ↔ OLC.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: Sistémica Total / PM ↔ MoC ↔ PF ↔ OLC row
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 maps four-model systemic contradiction to Incoherencia Sistémica Total and treats Esquizofrenia Organizacional as alias.

matrix.title: Evidence must identify models
matrix.ruleText: Every diagnostic input must declare the model set involved: PM, MoC, PF, OLC or a cross-model combination.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 rows are organized by implicated models and model combinations.
matrix.requiredCorrection: Optional later package correction: expose explicit input_contract.involved_models.
matrix.auditorNotes: Semantically supported; exact input field name is not explicit in package contract.

matrix.title: Evidence must identify inconsistency class
matrix.ruleText: Every diagnostic input must declare inconsistency class: factual, temporal, structural alternatives, structural iterations, composite factual, temporal-intentional, structural-ontological, causal-operational or systemic total.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 classifies each row by inconsistency type.
matrix.requiredCorrection: Optional later package correction: expose explicit input_contract.inconsistency_compartment or inconsistency_type.
matrix.auditorNotes: Semantically supported; exact input contract section remains implicit.

matrix.title: Evidence must include source_trace
matrix.ruleText: Every diagnostic candidate must preserve source_trace to the evidence item, model element, gate output or structural candidate that triggered it.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 require governed evidence, readiness and auditable source trace before downstream use.

matrix.title: Conformance status required
matrix.ruleText: If any involved model lacks conformance status, the candidate must be blocked_by_conformance_unchecked.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D1 establishes conformance evaluation before model use.
matrix.requiredCorrection: Optional later package correction: expose explicit input_contract.conformance_status.
matrix.auditorNotes: Semantically supported; exact input field name remains implicit.

matrix.title: Consistency status required
matrix.ruleText: If the cross-model inconsistency has not been evaluated by the corresponding consistency compartment, the candidate must be blocked_by_consistency_unchecked.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D1 governs consistency evaluation and D2 defines cross-model inconsistency compartments.
matrix.requiredCorrection: Optional later package correction: expose explicit input_contract.consistency_status.
matrix.auditorNotes: Semantically supported; exact input field name remains implicit.

matrix.title: Ambiguity routes to manual review
matrix.ruleText: If evidence is semantically ambiguous, route to manual_review_required instead of forcing a pathology mapping.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: Runtime boundary supports blocking/manual review rather than forced diagnostic output when evidence is insufficient.

matrix.title: Single strongest compartment
matrix.ruleText: When multiple compartments fire, preserve all candidates but identify a primary_candidate only if one has higher evidence_strength and broader model coverage.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 defines compartments with varying model coverage; choosing a primary candidate by evidence/model coverage is a faithful governance abstraction.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; conservative because it preserves all candidates.

matrix.title: Systemic total requires cascade evidence
matrix.ruleText: Incoherencia Sistémica Total requires contradiction evidence across all four views, not merely two isolated inconsistencies.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: Sistémica Total / PM ↔ MoC ↔ PF ↔ OLC row
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 defines systemic total as four-model cascading contradiction, not an isolated pairwise issue.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; prevents overuse of systemic label.

matrix.title: Temporal PF-OLC distinction
matrix.ruleText: Tortura Causal requires sequence/order violation; Violación Causal requires forcing an invalid state or transition. Do not collapse them.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: PF ↔ OLC factual row; PF ↔ OLC temporal row; MMABP consistency distinction
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 separates factual PF/OLC invalid state from temporal PF/OLC sequence inconsistency.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; preserves D2 distinction.

matrix.title: Structural PF-OLC distinction
matrix.ruleText: Falsa Elección requires mismatch between PF alternatives/gateways and OLC causal alternatives. Do not classify every PF/OLC issue as Falsa Elección.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: PF ↔ OLC structural alternatives row; MMABP consistency distinction
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 separates alternatives mismatch from other PF/OLC inconsistencies.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; prevents broad misclassification.

matrix.title: MoC-PF-OLC causal operational distinction
matrix.ruleText: Competencia Causal requires the object operation to be structurally allowed by MoC but causally unauthorized by OLC at that state while PF executes it.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 describes structural capability, causal authorization and process execution contradiction.

matrix.title: Aliases are not new pathologies
matrix.ruleText: Aliases such as Esquizofrenia Organizacional must be stored as aliases of an approved pathology label, not as independent ontology entries unless a source explicitly authorizes it.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 names Incoherencia Sistémica Total and includes Esquizofrenia Organizacional parenthetically.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; alias does not create a 14th canonical pathology.

matrix.title: Output type is diagnostic_preclassification_candidate
matrix.ruleText: The only runtime output of this chip is diagnostic_preclassification_candidate or blocked/manual_review state.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 allow readiness/preclassification evidence and block final diagnosis/export.

matrix.title: Output must include method trace
matrix.ruleText: Each output must include method_trace with involved models, inconsistency_type, compartment_id, evidence_refs and source_refs.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: method validation, D2 row structure, Capa 1 traceability
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D1/D2 supply method and compartment evidence; D4 requires governed traceable evidence.

matrix.title: Output must include pathology trace
matrix.ruleText: Each output must include pathology_trace with pathology label, diagnostic question, pathology statement and source D2 row.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 provides pathology label, diagnostic question and pathology statement for each row.

matrix.title: Output must include correction boundary
matrix.ruleText: The chip may recommend that the architecture return to factual evidence; it must not directly rewrite models or align them cosmetically.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: method validation and pathology evidence boundary
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D1/D2 support evidence-based evaluation rather than cosmetic rewrite.

matrix.title: Output must include readiness boundary
matrix.ruleText: Output must expose whether it is ready_for_parallel_production_prep, ready_with_flags, blocked, reentry_required or manual_review_required.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 define readiness/preclassification and blocked/manual-review boundaries.

matrix.title: B7/C20 non-diagnostic boundary
matrix.ruleText: B7/C20 signals may prepare low-confidence preclassification but must not generate IR, registry, export or final diagnosis.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 state B7/C20 do not produce MoC/IR/registry/export directly and remain readiness/preclassification only.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; no final diagnosis enabled.

matrix.title: SEM gate before MoC/OLC pathology
matrix.ruleText: If the inconsistency depends on object/state/class/attribute ambiguity, the Semantic Resolution Gate must close before mapping a pathology candidate.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D5 uses SEM gate as runtime readiness boundary for semantic ambiguity.

matrix.title: PST gate before PF/OLC pathology
matrix.ruleText: If the inconsistency depends on waits, blocking or timers, the Process State/Timer Gate must close before mapping PF/OLC temporal or causal pathology.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D5 uses PST gate as runtime readiness boundary for process state/timer ambiguity.

matrix.title: No exposure of internal diagnosis to UI
matrix.ruleText: The UI may show sober user-facing continuity language; it must not expose pathology labels unless a later explicit diagnostic surface authorizes it.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 keep Capa 1 evidence governed and non-diagnostic; diagnostic labels are not user-facing unless future surface authorizes it.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; no UI exposure is wired.

matrix.title: Production Paralela consumes governed candidates only
matrix.ruleText: Downstream consumers must receive governed evidence/candidate payloads, not raw text or unvalidated pathology labels.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4/D5 prohibit raw-text export and require governed evidence/readiness payloads.
matrix.auditorNotes: Critical rule reviewed; downstream raw text is blocked.

matrix.title: Manifest must count compartments
matrix.ruleText: Manifest must report exactly 13 diagnostic compartments for v0.1 unless a later approved source changes the ontology.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 provides 13 diagnostic compartments.

matrix.title: Manifest must count pathologies
matrix.ruleText: Manifest must report 13 canonical pathology mappings for v0.1; aliases do not increase canonical count.
matrix.originalSourceUnit: D2 pathology column and systemic-total alias
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D2 has 13 canonical pathology mappings; Esquizofrenia Organizacional appears as alias under Incoherencia Sistémica Total.

matrix.title: No internal GPT instructions compiled
matrix.ruleText: Instrucciones Maestras and Instrucciones Actualizadas are not compiled as platform sources in this chip; they remain assistant-internal context only.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: The package explicitly excludes internal GPT instruction documents as compiled sources.
matrix.auditorNotes: Project decision is explicit and source_ref is not missing.

matrix.title: No generated rules without source
matrix.ruleText: Every rule must carry at least one source_ref or explicitly mark project_decision for governance decisions made in this conversation.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: The rector sources and project governance require every operational rule to trace to a source or explicit project decision.
matrix.auditorNotes: All 45 rules have source_refs or project_decision.

matrix.title: Source checksums recorded
matrix.ruleText: All source documents used by the chip must have existence, size and sha256 recorded in manifest.
matrix.sourceQuoteShortOrSummary: D4 audit/readiness boundary supports source traceability; manifest records D1/D2/D4/D5 existence, size and sha256.
